disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫的凭据路径引用（规则 DSH-C01/DG-R1-51）逐条核对：命中仅在 README 与预置说明里出现 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`，属使用文档，告诉用户把视觉后端 Key 放哪里；代码未发现读取该文件、SSH 目录或云凭据目录的逻辑。
checked_items.en: Mechanical pre-scan credential path references (rules DSH-C01/DG-R1-51) checked one by one: matches appear only in README and preset instructions as `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, which is usage documentation telling users where to put the visual backend key; no logic in the code reads that file, the SSH directory, or cloud credential directories.

checked_items.zh: 核对密钥处理链路：插件只在用户选定视觉后端时经宿主凭据通道取 Key，密钥仅以哈希指纹参与熔断决策；日志模块在写入前统一脱敏（Bearer、sk- 前缀、查询参数与请求头中的密钥形态都被替换），未发现密钥读取后外发或落盘的路径。
checked_items.en: Credential handling chain checked: the plugin only retrieves the key via the host credential channel when the user selects a visual backend; the key participates in circuit-breaker decisions only as a hash fingerprint; the logging module uniformly redacts before writing (Bearer, sk- prefix, query parameters, and key-like forms in request headers are all replaced); no path was found where the key is exfiltrated or written to disk after being read.

evidence.zh: 核查凭据读取与外联组合：未发现代码读取凭据文件，README 与预置说明中的凭据存放指引只是使用文档；密钥经宿主凭据通道获取后仅做哈希指纹用于熔断，不落日志、不外发。
evidence.en: Credential read and outbound combination examined: no code reads credential files; the credential storage guidance in README and preset instructions is merely usage documentation; after the key is obtained via the host credential channel, it is only used as a hash fingerprint for circuit breaking, and is not logged or exfiltrated.

checked_items.zh: 核查可见工具描述（识图问答、像素定位、裁剪、OCR 等视觉工具与自动挂载提示）：均为功能使用说明，教模型如何调用工具，未发现系统指令、忽略规则、索要凭据或诱导安装改配置的措辞。
checked_items.en: Visible tool descriptions examined (image Q&A, pixel positioning, cropping, OCR and other vision tools plus auto-mount hints): all are functional usage instructions teaching the model how to call the tools; no wording was found for system instructions, ignore rules, credential solicitation, or inducing installation/configuration changes.

checked_items.zh: 审查运行时两个挂接点（规则 DSH-L03/DG-R2-58 与 DSH-L01/DG-R4-54）：pre-step 监听只记录图片引用、清洗工具结果并追加『有图可调用识图工具』的提示；request 监听只在含图轮次把请求路由到用户配置的视觉链。两者均未改写或注入用户消息原意。
checked_items.en: Two runtime hook points reviewed (rules DSH-L03/DG-R2-58 and DSH-L01/DG-R4-54): the pre-step listener only records image references, cleans tool results, and appends a hint that an image tool is available; the request listener only routes image-bearing turns to the user-configured vision chain. Neither rewrites or injects into the user's original message intent.

checked_items.zh: 检查仓库模型面指令文件（AGENTS.md/SKILL.md 等）：根目录清单中未发现此类文件，机械预扫 DSH-X10 无命中。
checked_items.en: Repository model-facing instruction files checked (AGENTS.md/SKILL.md etc.): no such files found in the root listing; mechanical pre-scan DSH-X10 had no matches.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与提示片段均为功能说明，未发现注入系统指令或诱导模型行为的措辞。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and prompt fragments are functional instructions; no wording that injects system instructions or induces model behavior was found.

evidence.zh: 工具描述中未发现诱导模型执行安装命令、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: No wording in tool descriptions induces the model to execute install commands, rewrite configuration, or relax permissions.

evidence.zh: pre-step 监听只记录图片引用并清洗工具结果，未向消息注入指令或篡改用户输入。
evidence.en: The pre-step listener only records image references and cleans tool results; it does not inject instructions into messages or tamper with user input.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫的 child_process 命中（规则 DSH-X03/DG-R3-55）逐条核对：execFile/spawnSync 用于 OCR（tesseract 兼容层）、诊断工具、日志与用户主动触发的插件更新，均无 shell 拼接、无远程载荷下载执行；测试目录中的 new Function 是测试脚手架。未发现 eval 执行不可信输入。
checked_items.en: Mechanical pre-scan child_process matches (rules DSH-X03/DG-R3-55) checked one by one: execFile/spawnSync are used for OCR (tesseract compatibility layer), diagnostic tools, logging, and user-triggered plugin updates; none involve shell concatenation or downloading and executing remote payloads; the new Function in test directories is test scaffolding. No eval of untrusted input was found.

checked_items.zh: 核对挂载补丁（规则 DSH-P01/DSH-P02）：bundle 的 cordis.patch.yml 只插入插件行并调整附件大小上限，无 `!!js` 可执行标量；预置目录为纯配置样例。
checked_items.en: Patch check (rules DSH-P01/DSH-P02): the bundle's cordis.patch.yml only inserts plugin lines and adjusts attachment size limits; no `!!js` executable scalar; preset directory is a pure configuration example.

checked_items.zh: 核对安装钩子与树内执行载体（规则 DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 与 DSH-X07/DG-R3-59）：package.json 无安装后执行脚本（仅有 test 脚本）；仓库 CI 工作流（.github/workflows）只在 GitHub 构建机上运行，不进入用户机器执行面，按审计范围约定不计入插件运行风险。
checked_items.en: Install hook and in-tree execution carrier check (rules DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 and DSH-X07/DG-R3-59): package.json has no post-install scripts (only a test script); the repo CI workflows (.github/workflows) run only on GitHub build machines and never enter the execution surface of user machines; per audit scope convention, they are not counted as plugin runtime risk.

checked_items.zh: 核对浏览器端 bundle（规则 DSH-X04/DG-R3-56 与 DSH-X05/DG-R3-57）：声明 dsh.client；键盘监听用于界面关闭与引导弹窗，剪贴板写入用于『复制诊断报告』按钮，均未发现键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或调用凭据特权接口的行为。
checked_items.en: Browser bundle check (rules DSH-X04/DG-R3-56 and DSH-X05/DG-R3-57): declares dsh.client; keyboard listeners are for UI dismissal and onboarding popups; clipboard write is for the "copy diagnostic report" button; no keyboard logging, clipboard theft, or calls to privileged credential interfaces were found.

checked_items.zh: 核对混淆信号（规则 DSH-X08/DG-R3-60）：长行命中为 SVG 图片与压缩打包的客户端界面代码；转义密度命中为控制字符清洗正则（日志与文本脱敏用），属防御性代码，非混淆载荷。
checked_items.en: Obfuscation signal check (rule DSH-X08/DG-R3-60): long-line matches are SVG images and compressed client UI code; escape-density matches are control-character cleaning regex (for log and text redaction), which is defensive code, not obfuscated payload.

evidence.zh: bundle 挂载补丁已全文核对：只含插件插入行与附件上限配置，无 `!!js` 可执行标量，不会在宿主进程执行任意 JS。
evidence.en: The bundle patch was fully reviewed: it contains only plugin insertion lines and attachment limit configuration; no `!!js` executable scalar; it cannot execute arbitrary JS in the host process.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用，该场景不适用。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) found; this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装后执行脚本；CI 工作流仅作用于 GitHub 构建机，不进入用户机器；无 prepare 钩子，也无下载即执行的文档引导。
evidence.en: package.json has no post-install scripts; CI workflows act only on GitHub build machines and do not reach user machines; no prepare hook and no documentation guiding download-then-execute.

evidence.zh: 浏览器 bundle 抽查了键盘与剪贴板用法，均为界面交互（关闭弹窗、复制报告），未发现窃取输入或调用特权接口的行为。
evidence.en: Spot-checked keyboard and clipboard usage in the browser bundle: both are UI interactions (closing popups, copying reports); no input theft or privileged interface calls found.

evidence.zh: 未发现后台任务、定时提醒或持久目标等常驻注册；后台能力评测默认关闭，需用户显式开启，属声明功能。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled reminders, or persistent targets registered; background capability evaluation is off by default and requires explicit user opt-in; it is a declared feature.

checked_items.zh: 核对网络出口（规则 DSH-C03/DG-R4-51 与 DSH-C05/DG-R4-53）：外联域名集中于视觉后端（open.bigmodel.cn、opencode.ai/zen/go）、更新检查（registry.npmjs.org、github.com/api.github.com）与本地视觉后端（127.0.0.1:11434、localhost:1234），与声明能力一致；未发现裸 IP、隧道、paste/gist 等带外通道。
checked_items.en: Network egress check (rules DSH-C03/DG-R4-51 and DSH-C05/DG-R4-53): outbound domains concentrate on vision backends (open.bigmodel.cn, opencode.ai/zen/go), update checks (registry.npmjs.org, github.com/api.github.com), and local vision backends (127.0.0.1:11434, localhost:1234), consistent with declared capabilities; no raw IPs, tunnels, or paste/gist-style out-of-band channels found.

checked_items.zh: 审查 LLM 路由挂接（规则 DSH-L02/DG-R4-55 与 DSH-L01/DG-R4-54）：注册适配器与请求路由的用途是把含图轮次送到用户配置的视觉链（官方 DeepSeek、用户自配的 OpenAI 兼容端点、本地 Ollama/LM Studio），未发现把请求重定向到未声明端点或夹带外发的适配器。
checked_items.en: LLM routing hook review (rules DSH-L02/DG-R4-55 and DSH-L01/DG-R4-54): adapter registration and request routing exist to send image-bearing turns to the user-configured vision chain (official DeepSeek, user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoints, local Ollama/LM Studio); no adapter redirecting requests to undeclared endpoints or smuggling outbound data was found.

checked_items.zh: 核对自更新链路：仅由用户在设置页主动触发，路由受回环地址围栏保护且仅接受 POST，更新命令不经过 shell、执行前校验 profile 归属并验证版本生效，未发现后台静默下载执行。
checked_items.en: Self-update chain checked: triggered only actively by the user on the settings page; route is protected by loopback address fencing and accepts only POST; update command does not go through a shell, profile ownership is validated before execution, and version activation is verified; no background silent download-and-execute found.

evidence.zh: 模型路由挂接与适配器注册均指向插件声明的视觉后端（官方 DeepSeek、用户配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点、本地后端），未发现重定向到未声明端点或借路由夹带外发的行为。
evidence.en: Model routing hooks and adapter registration all point to the plugin's declared vision backends (official DeepSeek, user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoints, local backends); no redirect to undeclared endpoints or exfiltration smuggled through routing found.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖与身份：运行时依赖为 schemastery、potrace、puppeteer-core、undici，peer 依赖为官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh 系列包；未发现与生态命名撞车的可疑依赖、未锁定 commit 的 git 依赖（规则 DSH-S04/DG-R5-56）或安装钩子。
checked_items.en: Dependencies and identity checked: runtime dependencies are schemastery, potrace, puppeteer-core, undici; peer dependencies are the official @deepseek-ai/dsh series; no suspicious dependencies name-colliding with the ecosystem, no git dependencies without pinned commits (rule DSH-S04/DG-R5-56), and no install hooks were found.

checked_items.zh: 核对挂载补丁是否触碰安全配置行（规则 DSH-P03/DG-R5-51、DSH-P04/DG-R5-52、DSH-P05/DG-R5-53）：bundle 补丁只插入插件行并调整附件存储上限，未对沙箱/审批/权限行做禁用或环境变量降权，未改写 inject/intercept。
checked_items.en: Patch touching security configuration lines checked (rules DSH-P03/DG-R5-51, DSH-P04/DG-R5-52, DSH-P05/DG-R5-53): the bundle patch only inserts plugin lines and adjusts attachment storage limits; it does not disable sandbox/approval/permission lines or downgrade via environment variables, and does not rewrite inject/intercept.

checked_items.zh: 作者 ysr666 未验证（身份加权项，不单独判风险）；上一版 1.7.6 审计结论为 clean，本版未发现供应链侧突变，无历史改写信号。
checked_items.en: Author ysr666 is unverified (identity weighting item, not rated as risk alone); the previous version 1.7.6 audit concluded clean; this version shows no supply chain mutation and no historical rewrite signals.

evidence.zh: 补丁未触碰沙箱/审批/权限配置行，未出现 disabled 或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch does not touch sandbox/approval/permission configuration lines; no disabled flag or environment-variable downgrade pattern appears.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批或工具预执行瀑布流事件的高优先级短路监听，该场景不适用。
evidence.en: No high-priority short-circuit listeners for approval or tool pre-execution waterfall events found; this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 本次为单快照完整审计，无版本间清单变更可供比对，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: This is a single-snapshot full audit; no between-version manifest changes to compare; the upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不会给安全插件追加虚假必需服务导致其永久等待。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration; it cannot append a fake required service to security plugins and cause them to wait forever.

checked_items.zh: 核对自建网络服务（规则 DSH-S03/DG-R6-51）：插件未自行监听端口，只向宿主 WebServer 注册设置页与更新接口路由，这些路由经回环地址围栏保护并限制方法；本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有风险，非本插件新增。
checked_items.en: Self-hosted network service check (rule DSH-S03/DG-R6-51): the plugin does not listen on ports itself; it only registers settings page and update interface routes with the host WebServer, which are protected by loopback fencing and method restrictions; unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem, not newly introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 核对子代理委派与动态沙箱：未发现注册外部子代理提供方（规则 DSH-L04/DG-R3-62）的调用；动态沙箱未启用（本审计未做动态验证），运行时行为判定仅基于静态证据。
checked_items.en: Sub-agent delegation and dynamic sandbox check: no calls registering external sub-agent providers (rule DSH-L04/DG-R3-62); dynamic sandbox not enabled (no dynamic validation in this audit); runtime behavior judgments are based on static evidence only.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口；宿主本机无认证 RPC 是生态固有风险，非本插件问题，故标注不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports itself; unauthenticated local RPC on the host is an inherent ecosystem risk, not a plugin issue, hence marked not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未发现注册外部子代理提供方的代码，该场景不适用。
evidence.en: No code registering external sub-agent providers found; this scenario is not applicable.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：dsh 声明齐全（bundle 补丁 + 客户端 bundle），作者未验证但无仿冒信号。
summary.en: Metadata and identity check passed: dsh declarations complete (bundle patch + client bundle); author unverified but no impersonation signals.

summary.zh: 静态扫描命中逐条裁决完毕：child_process/执行面命中均为 OCR、诊断与用户主动更新等良性用途，未发现恶意 sink。
summary.en: All static scan matches adjudicated: child_process/execution-surface matches are benign uses such as OCR, diagnostics, and user-initiated updates; no malicious sinks found.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子，外联域名均为视觉后端与更新检查，自更新为用户主动触发且受回环围栏保护。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks; outbound domains are only vision backends and update checks; self-update is user-triggered and protected by loopback fencing.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述、路由挂接与 pre-step 消息处理均与声明的识图业务自洽，未发现注入措辞或恶意路由。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions, routing hooks, and pre-step message handling are self-consistent with the declared image- Q&A business; no injection wording or malicious routing found.

summary.zh: 未做动态验证：本审计未提供动态沙箱产物（l4-sandbox.json 不存在）。
summary.en: No dynamic validation performed: this audit did not provide dynamic sandbox artifacts (l4-sandbox.json does not exist).

target.en: dsh-vision-router@2.0.0#7ec4c40 (repo root plugin, release-full full audit)

limits.zh:
未做动态沙箱验证（L4 未启用，context/l4-sandbox.json 不存在），运行时行为判定仅基于静态证据。

读取预算在本次运行中耗尽，部分整树重扫（预置 yaml 全量内容、AGENTS/SKILL 类模型面指令文件的更深层搜索、web-capability-boundary.js 与 presets 配置的精读）未能完成；已基于静态预扫命中清单与已精读文件完成逐条裁决，机械预扫自身标注为尽力覆盖（truncated），未覆盖区间不得视为已扫无恙。

package.json 未显式声明能力清单，declared_capabilities 按代码实测推断（网络、shell、文件写入、模型面），capability_diff 的 declared 侧为推断值。

版本对比信号（新增外联域名、能力升级、工具描述变更）基于当前快照的良性状态保守置否；本次为 release-full 单快照审计，未提供基线 diff 数据，未做逐域比对。
limits.en:
No dynamic sandbox validation performed (L4 not enabled, context/l4-sandbox.json does not exist); runtime behavior judgments are based on static evidence only.

The read budget was exhausted in this run; some full-tree rescans (full content of preset YAML, deeper searches for model-facing instruction files like AGENTS/SKILL, and deep reading of web-capability-boundary.js and presets configuration) could not be completed; adjudications were done one by one based on the static pre-scan hit list and already-read files; the mechanical pre-scan itself is marked as best-effort coverage (truncated), and uncovered ranges must not be considered scanned clean.

package.json does not explicitly declare a capability list; declared_capabilities are inferred from actual code observations (network, shell, file write, model-facing); the declared side of capability_diff is an inferred value.

Version comparison signals (new outbound domains, capability upgrades, tool description changes) are conservatively set to no based on the benign state of the current snapshot; this is a release-full single-snapshot audit, no baseline diff data provided, no per-domain comparison made.
